description: Search Property Finder listings across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain and Egypt, or scrape listing, agent and broker URLs. Returns property details and public brokerage contact data.

agentUrls.description: Property Finder agent profile URLs, or bare numeric agent IDs. Used with mode=agents.
agentUrls.sectionDescription: Agent and broker profiles return public profile data and the brokerage's published contact details.
agentUrls.title: Agent profile URLs or IDs

bedrooms.description: Bedroom filter for residential searches. Studio is supported for apartments and mixed-type searches.
bedrooms.title: Bedrooms

brokerUrls.description: Property Finder broker/agency profile URLs, or bare numeric broker IDs. Used with mode=brokers.
brokerUrls.title: Broker profile URLs or IDs

city.description: City, province or governorate to search. Choose All cities for a country-wide search.
city.title: City / province

completionStatus.description: Ready or off-plan. Applies to residential for-sale searches; ignored for rentals and commercial searches.
completionStatus.title: Completion status

country.description: Market to search or the country used for bare agent/broker ids.
country.sectionDescription: Used with mode=search. Pick a city that belongs to this country, or choose All cities.
country.title: Country

furnishing.description: Furnished or unfurnished. Leave on Any furnishing to include both.
furnishing.title: Furnishing

includeDetails.description: Open each listing page to add the full photo gallery, permit validation link, licences, floor plans and agent ratings. Turn off for a faster, lighter dataset.
includeDetails.title: Include full listing details

maxItems.description: Maximum number of listings or profiles to return.
maxItems.sectionDescription: The run stops at this many records or when the source runs out.
maxItems.title: Max records

mode.description: What to scrape. Search listings by filters, scrape specific listing URLs, or collect agent/broker profiles.
mode.title: Mode

priceMax.description: Maximum asking price in the market's local currency.
priceMax.title: Maximum price

priceMin.description: Minimum asking price in the market's local currency (AED, SAR, QAR, BHD or EGP).
priceMin.title: Minimum price

propertyType.description: Residential types: apartment, villa, townhouse, penthouse, duplex, compound, land, whole building, half floor. Commercial types: office, shop, warehouse, factory, showroom.
propertyType.title: Property type

purpose.description: Buy, rent, or the commercial equivalents.
purpose.title: Purpose

startUrls.description: Property Finder landing, search, listing or short URLs. Used with mode=listings. Sitemap and sitemap-index URLs are also accepted.
startUrls.sectionDescription: Use these instead of the search filters when you already have Property Finder links.
startUrls.title: Listing or search URLs

title: Property Finder MENA Listings & Brokerage Contacts Input
